verses.html: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;
verses.text: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;
verses.title: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.
verses.titleHtml: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.

verses.html: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.
verses.text: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.

verses.html: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.
verses.text: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.

verses.html: For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.
verses.text: For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.

verses.html: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
verses.text: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

verses.html: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.
verses.text: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.

verses.html: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.
verses.text: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.

verses.html: Let his days be few; and let another take his office.
verses.text: Let his days be few; and let another take his office.

verses.html: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
verses.text: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

verses.html: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.
verses.text: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.

verses.html: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.
verses.text: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.

verses.html: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.
verses.text: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.

verses.html: Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.
verses.text: Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.

verses.html: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the LORD; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
verses.text: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the LORD; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

verses.html: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.
verses.text: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.

verses.html: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.
verses.text: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.

verses.html: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.
verses.text: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.

verses.html: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.
verses.text: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.

verses.html: Let it be unto him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.
verses.text: Let it be unto him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.

verses.html: Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from the LORD, and of them that speak evil against my soul.
verses.text: Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from the LORD, and of them that speak evil against my soul.

verses.html: But do thou for me, O GOD the Lord, for thy name's sake: because thy mercy is good, deliver thou me.
verses.text: But do thou for me, O GOD the Lord, for thy name's sake: because thy mercy is good, deliver thou me.

verses.html: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.
verses.text: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.

verses.html: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.
verses.text: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.

verses.html: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.
verses.text: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.

verses.html: I became also a reproach unto them: when they looked upon me they shaked their heads.
verses.text: I became also a reproach unto them: when they looked upon me they shaked their heads.

verses.html: Help me, O LORD my God: O save me according to thy mercy:
verses.text: Help me, O LORD my God: O save me according to thy mercy:

verses.html: That they may know that this is thy hand; that thou, LORD, hast done it.
verses.text: That they may know that this is thy hand; that thou, LORD, hast done it.

verses.html: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.
verses.text: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.

verses.html: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.
verses.text: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.

verses.html: I will greatly praise the LORD with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.
verses.text: I will greatly praise the LORD with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.

verses.html: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those that condemn his soul.
verses.text: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those that condemn his soul.
